protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: User-Agent matching /webmin/i disables cookie-session authentication, after which HTTP Basic validation accepts a password for a 2FA-protected account without validating the second factor. The vendor page and the published CVE record describe this same password-required 2FA bypass.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: b30868ce165f57b25300cfc45f3504c1be07e202 deletes the four-line HTTP-auth rejection while converting session-login 2FA lookup to get_user_details(). The earlier 2013 session-only integration gap was closed by b178d99667227da4288ed9019125e74a4c2b55e8 before their first common release tag 1.700; b30868ce165f57b25300cfc45f3504c1be07e202 is the atomic regression starting the affected released lineage.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: immediate parent 6862d147f1400f7087989d0aa00ade7021c78487 contains the Basic-auth guard rejecting users present in the two-factor map, while b30868ce165f57b25300cfc45f3504c1be07e202 removes it. The vulnerability is absent in the parent, so introducer_parent_absent must be true.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED NOT APPLICABLE: b30868ce165f57b25300cfc45f3504c1be07e202 is a single-parent commit whose only parent is 6862d147f1400f7087989d0aa00ade7021c78487, not a merge, move, or squash aggregate; no member decomposition is required.
protocol_checks.affected_fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED: b30868ce165f57b25300cfc45f3504c1be07e202 is an ancestor of affected tag 2.630; da18a16c84ae5c0b78cad79609cb0efb174000ec is not. The fix is an ancestor of tags 2.640 and 2.641, and 2.640 contains twofactor_blocked. CVE.org currently states affected versions below 2.640 and unaffected 2.640; the vendor security page places the issue under prior to 2.640. The GHSA description's 2.641 text is stale.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED DIRECT FIX: da18a16c84ae5c0b78cad79609cb0efb174000ec adds a get_user_details(...)->{twofactor_provider} check immediately after Basic credential validation, clears the validated user for 2FA accounts, and records a twofactor-required error. Its parent 0424a98a9b7b8c5a6166eff48a0f427dd53d31fa lacks that check.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: CONFIRMED: the exact BIC object names Jamie Cameron as author and committer on 2017-12-24 and has only the LDAP two-factor bug-fix subject, with no co-author, generated-with, bot, or other AI marker. Attribution does not rely on the 2026 fix, so NOT_AI is supported.

findings: The primary's mechanism, BIC, direct fix, release boundary, and NOT_AI verdict independently reproduce from the advisory and clone.
The structured field introducer_parent_absent is false even though the primary evidence and independent parent-tree check establish that the vulnerable state is absent in the immediate parent.
